shortcut_name: linear independence is exactly a triangle
evidence: "Case 1: Check for a triangle (3-clique)"; "Find common neighbor w > v"; the gpt-oss solution builds an adjacency matrix and searches neighbor triples
affordance_in_statement: x_{i,j} = 1 if step s_i and step s_j require a shared calibration tool, and x_{i,j} = 0 if they do not require a shared tool, or if i = j; the vectors must be "linearly independent over the real numbers"
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving way to remove this shortcut: for a three-vertex undirected binary adjacency matrix with zero diagonal, the determinant is 2 times the product of the three edge indicators, so linear independence is intrinsically equivalent to all three pairwise edges being present. Any rewording that preserves the task leaves the triangle criterion intact.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Reduces the condition to finding a triangle by scanning each edge for a common third neighbor.
Explicitly handles a 3-clique as the decisive linearly independent configuration.
Uses adjacency membership and an adjacency matrix to search for three vertices forming the required triangle.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The solution constructs "mat = [[False] * (n + 1) ...]" and iterates over ordered neighbors.

common_affordance: The zero-diagonal symmetric binary adjacency vectors make linear independence equivalent to the selected three steps forming a triangle.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It enumerates all vertex triples using itertools.combinations and performs explicit determinant checks with an O(n^2) adjacency matrix, leading to excessive time and memory for the fixed bounds.

recommended_edit: No valid single edit can defeat all survivors without changing the mathematical task: the triangle reduction is the task's intrinsic structure, not incidental wording. If changing the task is permitted, replace the zero-diagonal binary adjacency-vector criterion with a genuinely weighted or otherwise non-binary vector construction, so the determinant is no longer forced to equal twice the product of the three edge indicators.
regression_risk: Any superficial rewording or equivalent determinant formulation will preserve the triangle reduction and will not defeat the surviving triangle-search solutions.
